images.name: ゼロヴェイル
images.prompt: Create a premium original monster design for the Japanese creature-collecting RPG Pachi Monsters, FINAL EVOLUTION Zeroveil. Direction: dark, powerful, mischievous, iconic and immediately readable. A compact, heavy purple VOID BEAST standing on two short robust legs, low wide barrel torso and huge strong forearms with three ivory talons. It has an organic hood-like cranial silhouette merging into broad shoulders, NO ears, NO paired horns, NO hair or forelock. One low swept-back obsidian-violet blade ridge on top of its skull gives a distinct asymmetrical outline. The face is a dark charcoal-violet recessed mask with two narrow, luminous pale icy-blue eyes under heavy organic brow ridges. An off-center wicked black crescent mouth with just THREE irregular slender ivory fangs, not a broad white tooth grid. Saturated but restrained ink-purple skin, slate-violet highlights, very dark plum shadows, a tiny dark diamond indentation at the chest. A short thick tail sweeps low to one side and curls into a blunt crescent hook; a few clean geometric cuts at the tip suggest a void glitch, but no floating debris. No human-like smiling face, curved cartoon eyebrows, cute pompadour, big pale belly, pear-shaped toy body, human clothing, cape, armor, wings or jewelry. No red triangular eyes, pointed animal ears, spiny round ball shape, or huge wall of white teeth. The impression should be a charismatic small boss monster, muscular and supernatural, not a human mascot. Keep the anatomy simple and the silhouette bold, with refined shape design rather than lots of decorations. Render in exceptionally polished hand-placed 16-bit/32-bit Japanese RPG PIXEL ART, native-like 128x128 pixel logic per pose, crisp square clusters, carefully limited palette, dark outline and intentional lighting. A genuine transparent 2:1 landscape sprite atlas with TWO equal square cells. LEFT cell: full body front three-quarter view facing screen LEFT, face visible. RIGHT cell: full body independently drawn REAR three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT, show back/head/tail, no face on back, not a mirrored front. Same character, proportions and scale in both cells; feet aligned; generous transparent padding at edges and a clear empty central gap. No background, ground, cast shadows, words, names, labels, watermark, checkerboard or frame.
